messages:
nora_sales: Quick sync — ACME wants a 3mo POC commit but needs autoscale burst across mixed GPU pools (4x A100 + 2x H100) and an emergency spillover to hosted. Asking for a 25% commit discount + burst rate cap. docs and security Q inbound.

mike_pricing: Need numbers. Is the 25% off list or off committed rate? Also: what burst caps by GPU type?

nora_sales: 25% off the committed monthly spend. Burst: they want max 2x baseline throughput for 48h/month across the pool, and H100s should never exceed 60% of burst spend.

leo_infra: Operational note — multi-GPU-type burst + spillover to hosted requires cross-pool routing and quota guardrails. We can implement request-based throttles but SLA impact.

sarah_account: Customer legal also requested KMS + audit logs and an exception for burst billing to be capped for the POC. We should capture that in the deal doc.

mike_pricing: Running quick math. Proposed committed monthly: $120k (base pool). With 25% discount => $90k committed. Burst rates (on-demand) would be applied above commit: A100 $6/hr, H100 $18/hr. Cap the billed burst at +40% of committed spend for POC? If they need 2x throughput, 40% cap seems safe with mixed pool constraint.

nora_sales: Can we do a hard cap on customer invoice for burst? They want predictability for budget.

deal-desk-bot: FYI — Any commit discount >20% or custom burst caps require Deal Desk approval and finance sign-off. Please attach the pricing calc and customer PO.

mike_pricing: OK I'll prepare a spreadsheet and scenario calc. Quick snippet: 
```
commit_base = 120000
discount = 0.25
committed_billed = commit_base * (1-discount)  # 90000
burst_cap_pct = 0.4
max_burst_budget = committed_billed * burst_cap_pct  # 36000
```

leo_infra: Two ops flags: (1) enable quota isolation per-GPU-type, (2) require fallback policy to pinned hosted model variant if pool saturates. Both need SRE runbook updates.

sarah_account: I'll get the KMS + audit scoping done. Also need a short clause in SOW: "Burst billing capped at $36k for the POC; excess usage to be absorbed by Redwood for duration of POC subject to review." — are we ok with that?

mike_pricing: Finance won't love absorbing unlimited overage. We can accept absorbing up to $5k of overage as goodwill, beyond that we need either pre-authorized credit or daily alerting + throttle.

nora_sales: Customer prefers a clean single invoice. They want the cap written in SOW. Can we offer a one-time goodwill buffer of $5k and a hard invoice cap at $36k, with an emergency auth flow for any exceed?

deal-desk-bot: Marking for review. Required attachments: pricing calc, SOW draft, PO, security questionnaire snapshot. Tagging @deal-desk for human approval.

ops_bot: Note: enabling cross-pool burst routing will temporarily increase operator toil. Recommend scheduled maintenance window for config changes.

mike_pricing: I'll draft the deal terms: committed $90k/mo (3mo), burst cap $36k total over POC, goodwill overage $5k, rates A100 $6/hr, H100 $18/hr, hosted spillover enabled with fallback. Putting doc in Google Drive and pinging deal desk.

nora_sales: Thanks — looped in customer on the draft. Will push SOW + PO once legal confirms. Please escalate on Deal Desk if no reply in 12h. :pray:

leo_infra: If approved, I'll schedule config changes and add runbook steps.

deal-desk-bot: Action required: deal desk human review queued (priority: medium).

sarah_account: copying security Q answers; small items left. ETA EOD.

nora_sales: Great — will update thread once PO arrives.

mike_pricing: Added the pricing sheet here: https://drive.google.com/dir/example-poc-pricing (internal).
